== English Reflections III comparison ==
The named Appendix A entry and the current D-E1 face say “any immunity” where Decipher printed “all immunity.” The target loses its immunity to attrition for the remainder of the turn in both wordings. The actual faces both include “herself” in the lore. The pinned card data omits that word.
